mechanism: Minocycline is a photosensitizing agent that can increase serotonin-related side effects; both drugs independently carry low bleeding risk, and minocycline may inhibit hepatic metabolism of sertraline.
action: Monitor for increased serotonergic effects (agitation, tremor, serotonin syndrome); counsel patient on sun protection and watch for GI upset; no dose adjustment typically required but clinical monitoring is recommended.
